places.name: Shore Temple
places.description: One of India's oldest and most dramatically sited temples — the archetype of Dravidian architecture.
places.bestTime: Sunrise or sunset; October to March

places.name: Arjuna's Penance (Descent of the Ganges)
places.description: The largest and most complex bas-relief in the world, a masterpiece of Indian narrative sculpture.
places.bestTime: Morning for soft light on the relief

places.name: Pancha Rathas (Five Rathas)
places.description: Five entirely different architectural forms carved from one rock — a living textbook of early Dravidian design.
places.bestTime: Early morning before crowds; October to March

places.name: Krishna's Butter Ball
places.description: The world's most improbable rock — a giant sphere balanced on a slope that generations of engineers have failed to shift.
places.mapsSearch: Krishna's Butter Ball Mahabalipuram Tamil Nadu

places.name: Mahishasuramardini Cave
places.description: Two panels that represent the absolute peak of Pallava sculptural genius in a single intimate cave.
places.bestTime: Morning light enters the cave beautifully

places.name: Krishna Mandapam
places.description: The most charming and human of Mahabalipuram's rock carvings, with pastoral figures full of natural life.

places.name: Varaha Cave Temple
places.description: Four iconic Pallava relief panels in one compact cave — essential for understanding early South Indian Vaishnavism.
places.mapsSearch: Varaha Cave Temple Mahabalipuram Tamil Nadu

places.name: Mahabalipuram Beach
places.description: A rare beach where you can walk from a UNESCO heritage temple to a working fishing community in 20 minutes.

places.name: Lighthouse and Olakkanatha Temple
places.description: The best elevated vantage point for grasping the spatial arrangement of Mahabalipuram's entire heritage zone.
places.bestTime: Late afternoon for panoramic light; lighthouse open select mornings

places.name: Trimurthi Cave
places.description: One of the rare early temples depicting all three members of the Hindu Trimurti in equal standing.
